title: prune grading questions line
description: One yes/no question per line of grading/<grader>.questions.jsonl, written by `scripts/prune.mjs step`. Each asks whether one agent output follows the rule. The id is an opaque hash of the run, so a grader cannot tell which arm or harness produced the output.

id.description: An opaque run hash, a #, then complies.

kind.description: A probability that the condition holds, as a yes or no.

prompt.description: The question, with the rule's one-liner.

true.description: What a yes means, including that a diff touching nothing the rule governs complies.

criteria.description: What each answer means, in the form a judgment model takes for a yes/no question.

state.description: The whole § file and the diff the agent produced, in that order. The diff is cut at a file boundary when it is long.
